name: ChatBubble
summary: Chat message row. Renders an avatar (optional), an author name + timestamp meta, the message body, and a reaction bar slot. Three speaker variants — you (right-aligned, accent-tinted), them (left-aligned, raised), ai (left-aligned, AI-shimmer leading). Streaming AI messages render with a typing indicator until complete.

avatar.description: Avatar slot — pass an Avatar primitive.

time.description: Human time label. Render <time datetime=ISO> internally.

streaming.description: ai variant only. Renders a typing-indicator dot loop at the tail of the body.

reactions.description: Render-prop slot for a ReactionBar below the bubble.

actions.description: Trailing hover-revealed kebab + actions (Copy, Quote, Delete).

rules: Each ChatBubble is a <li>. The parent thread is <ol role='log' aria-live='polite'> so new messages are announced as they arrive.
AI streaming bubble uses aria-busy='true' until complete, then aria-busy='false'.
<time datetime=ISO> renders inside the meta row.
Reactions and actions are independently tabbable.

do: Avatar adjacent to bubble, not inside.
Use action.ai.bg.rest tint surface for ai variant; surface.raised for them.
dont: Don't render avatars inside the bubble — that wastes width.
Don't paint your-bubble in solid lime fill — use a tinted surface.
Don't auto-scroll to bottom on every keypress — only when the user is already at the bottom (sticky-bottom pattern).

changelog.note: Initial ChatBubble contract. Four speakers, streaming AI variant, ReactionBar slot.
